notes.title: New 2024 game "💲🐟Aquatic Supermarket Simulator🐟💲" revealed!
notes.content:
Hello gamers,

[h3]We have just announced a new game  [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3073580/Aquatic_Supermarket_Simulator][b]Aquatic Supermarket Simulator[/b][/url], a relaxing casual simulation game launching on Steam later this year. [/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3073580/Aquatic_Supermarket_Simulator/

[h3][b]Watch game trailer here[/b][/h3] [previewyoutube=kMWUMpQhMWA;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Want to know more? Check✅ [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3073580/Aquatic_Supermarket_Simulator]here[/url][/b]

[h2]Wishlist now to get free beta Early Access: [/h2] https://store.steampowered.com/app/3073580/Aquatic_Supermarket_Simulator/

Run your own aquatic-themed supermarket! Stock shelves with exotic fish and decorations, set prices, take payments, and maintain aquariums. Deliver fish, handle transactions, and ensure your customers are happy.


All the best,
FreeMind
